full_text_review.scope: All selected loose text, complete gzip streams, and all text members of ZIP archives; archive member paths and disguised Office formats checked in the first pass. No model deserialization.

excluded: Manuscript drafts, manuscript-authoring documents, private discussion archives, local credentials, host control queues and duplicate API readbacks. Scientific protocols and experiment reports remain evidence.
scope_note: Signature and filename checks, plus format and provenance inspection. Models were not executed or deserialized for this review.
